text: Sengar Files Expose CBI: Was the Probe Fair? | 1-Hour Special Investigation | Live-N18LThe Sengar Files raise disturbing questions about the role of the CBI in one of India’s most controversial cases. In this 1-hour special investigation, we examine whether the probe was conducted with neutrality—or whether critical decisions weakened the pursuit of justice. The CBI used a technical argument to claim that the accused MLA was not a public servant, a move that allegedly weakened the application of graver POCSO charges. Legal experts argue that this approach diluted the prosecution’s strength at a crucial stage. Was the agency prioritising defensiveness over accountability? The trial court’s “inescapable conclusion” that the investigation was not fair has further intensified scrutiny. Questions now arise over whether the probe was marked by bias rather than neutrality, and whether the victim was justified in alleging active collusion.
